thread:
Elena (Support): Hey team — customer 'BrightApps' on the free tier is getting a mix of 429s and occasional 401s during a sales demo. They hit our endpoints around 11:30 PDT and the demo is still running. Can we confirm if this is quota exhaustion vs auth flake? I'm attaching the snippets they sent.

Mira Chen: Thanks Elena. Pasted the error batch they forwarded: 
```
POST /v1/generate 429
{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit_error"}}
Response headers:
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 30
```
They also saw a couple of 401s for a short window: 
```
401 Unauthorized
{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key","type":"auth_error"}}
```
Looks like two separate things — primary is hitting token/request cap, secondary may be a rotated key in their demo env.

Alex P.: Confirming the free tier token cap for text-generation is 100k tokens/day and per-minute burst is 100 requests/min by default. If X-RateLimit-Remaining is 0 that's quota exhaustion. The 401s could be them toggling keys or a script that wipes env var during container restart. Ask them to check env var persistence.

Elena (Support): I asked for the account id and a short repro. They've given account_id: acct_bright_92 and an example curl they used to reproduce: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-large","prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
They said they ran that in a tight loop from a laptop during the demo (no backoff).

OpsBot: account acct_bright_92: quota alert triggered — daily tokens used 101,234 / 100,000 (100%) at 2026-03-15T18:30:12Z. Temporary burst already consumed.

Samir: Short-term mitigation: advise them to 1) add exponential backoff (start 500ms, cap 8s) on 429, 2) reduce max_tokens to 256 for demo, 3) reuse `chat` session / prefix caching if possible to avoid re-sending context every request. For the 401s, confirm the value of $REDWOOD_KEY at runtime — if they share a fleeting log we can verify.

Mira Chen: I also recommended switching to a lower-cost model (rwd-3-medium) for the demo; it drops per-token consumption by ~3x and will buy them more headroom. Sent sample prompt with `max_tokens:256` and `temperature:0.0` for consistency.

Elena (Support): Customer is asking if we can lift their quota for the demo (one-off) — they're on free tier and need a short burst until EOD PST. Can we do a temporary uplift or do we need sales sign-off?

Jonas (Sales): We can do a one-time sales-assisted uplift for demos, yes, but need customer legal name + expected tokens needed + payment intent (if moving to paid). For a free-tier exception I can authorize a 48-hour temporary increase to 500k tokens, but we need approval from finance for anything beyond that. Elena, can you get the estimated tokens for the remaining demo window?

Elena (Support): Asked BrightApps to confirm expected volume. They replied: approx 180k tokens more for the rest of the day (demo has batch of 60 users with ~3k tokens each). They also said they might go to paid after the demo.

Samir: Operational note — if we enable a temporary uplift we should also set a hard per-minute cap to avoid noisy noisy spike taking down other customers. Suggest policy: temporary_quota:500000, per_minute_limit:500. Also recommend enabling prefix cache and suggest model downgrade.

Mira Chen: I ran a quick permission check for acct_bright_92 — auth logs show 2 brief 401s at 18:28:03 and 18:28:07 from IP 52.24.13.9, then resumed. Looks like a short key reload or script restart. No sign of key compromise.

Elena (Support): I'm going to open a sales-assist ticket with Jonas. Forwarding account info and the customer's willingness to convert. I'm asking ops to provision a temporary uplift while we wait for sales-legal.

OpsBot: Provision request queued: uplift_request(acct_bright_92, 500000 tokens, 48h). Ticket# UPL-2026-331. Requires manual approval.

Jonas (Sales): Approved on my side for 48h. I'll run billing contact and follow up with a quick quote. Can you confirm whether the team wants invoice or card capture?

Elena (Support): Customer prefers to put it on card and switch to paid if the demo goes well. I've emailed them the conversion path and the quote link.

Samir: I'll also patch the endpoint to return a clearer `X-RateLimit-Policy` header in the next minor deploy so we can correlate daily vs burst caps in responses. For now, if you see `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` and `Retry-After`, it's the fast indicator.

Mira Chen: Repro steps I asked them to run (for our internal triage):
1) export REDWOOD_KEY to their shell
2) run the repro `while` loop but add `sleep 0.5` between requests
3) switch to `max_tokens:256` and `model:rwd-3-medium`
4) collect `curl -i` output showing response headers and paste here

Elena (Support): Will follow-up with customer and confirm temporary uplift was applied. If uplift isn't approved in Ops UI within 10 minutes, we'll escalate to SRE oncall to force it (they're in the thread).

Jonas (Sales): I'll take the handoff post-demo and propose an introductory monthly commit for Dedicated if they want predictable throughput.

Elena (Support): Thanks everyone — marking this thread for follow-up. BrightApps will test the reduced tokens & model change now and report back. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread
